full_title: Standard Reference Radiographs for Inspection of Aluminum and Magnesium Castings
issuing_organization: ASTM International (American Society for Testing and Materials)
compliance_scope: Industrial Radiographic NDT Quality Control & Defect Categorization

category_1.name: Gas Porosity (round voids)
category_1.description: Spherical or elongated voids caused by trapped hydrogen gas during molten metal cooling.
category_1.action: Degassing process audit required if Severity > Grade 3

category_2.name: Gas Porosity (elongated voids)
category_2.description: Elongated gas channels formed along cooling temperature gradients.
category_2.action: Immediate REJECT if located in primary load-bearing cross-section

category_3.name: Shrinkage Cavity
category_3.description: Internal voids formed due to volumetric contraction during liquid-to-solid phase change.
category_3.action: High fatigue failure risk; REJECT and scrap component

category_4.name: Foreign Inclusions (dense/less dense)
category_4.description: Oxide films, dross, or foreign particulate inclusions embedded in casting matrix.
category_4.action: Scrap component if inclusion size exceeds 1.5mm

radiographic_attenuation_rules.dark_anomalies: Low density voids / Gas bubbles / Shrinkage cavities
radiographic_attenuation_rules.bright_anomalies: High density foreign inclusions / Heavy metal particles
